[SWS_DM_01101] Debouncing parameters from Monitor Constructor
⌈
If
Debouncing parameters and methods are not present in DEXT, DM shall use the Monitor
Constructor values and Algorithm, as provided. In these instances, debouncing rele-
vant DEXT parameters in the following requirements shall be replaced by the Monitor
Constructor values.
⌋
